storyline.real: Norris, chasing his first win, stays on slick tyres as rain arrives in the closing laps; he slides off, pits for intermediates and finishes seventh, while Hamilton stops in time and wins.
storyline.headline: Norris reads the Sochi rain and takes his first win

mastery.label: Win with a switch to intermediates

eras.briefing: Sochi, 2021. Norris starts from his first pole position and leads Hamilton into the second half of the race. Rain is coming.
